rules.title: Hard-coded crypto key or IV
rules.message: Hard-coded keys/IVs in source are recoverable by anyone with the repo.
rules.fix: Load keys from a KMS/secret manager; generate unique IVs per message.

rules.title: MD5/SHA1 used near password hashing
rules.message: Fast hashes are unsuitable for passwords (offline cracking).
rules.fix: Use bcrypt, scrypt, Argon2, or PBKDF2 with strong parameters.

rules.title: TLS certificate verification disabled
rules.message: Disabling TLS verification enables MITM on sensitive traffic.
rules.fix: Keep verification on; fix trust stores instead of disabling checks.
